indicators.note: the abbreviation for husband breaks into the word for swiftly, cutting it open

parts.note: at a pace, i.e. quickly, is apace

clue.text: In this place belonging to daughter in cathedral city

parts.note: here means in this place

explanation.surface: Something here belongs to a daughter living in a cathedral city.

clue.text: Chief city in Middle East? Large container port set up

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means the words are written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: a silo is a large container for grain
taken as written

explanation.surface: A query about which major city in the Middle East has a big container port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns both words for the container and the port together, giving TROPOLIS; 'Large container' reads as a description of shipping but is a grain store.
explanation.definitionFit: A metropolis is the chief or capital city of a country or region.

indicators.note: not initially tells us to drop the first letter of the synonym

parts.note: inexpensive means cheap

clue.text: A goodwill message that bells broadcast around start of Easter

broadcast means scattered, so these letters are rearranged
start of signals the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Church bells ring out a goodwill message at the start of Easter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' scrambles THATBELLS, and 'around' wraps those letters about E from 'start of Easter'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a common farewell or greeting wishing someone good fortune.

indicators.note: from tells us the girl's name is taken out of the run of letters that follows

a government department or agency, as in a travel or news agency

parts.note: raised means up

parts.note: dealers trade
on means working, functioning, as a switched-on machine

parts.note: mode means fashion, as in 'the latest mode'

parts.note: a ruse is a trick
